svg.title: Seven instances of one mesh, from one draw call
svg.desc: The actual frame, rendered offscreen and downloaded so it can be counted rather than described. Seven tori, each at its own place and its own angle and its own tint, all drawn from a single vertex buffer and a single index buffer by one call to SDL_DrawGPUIndexedPrimitives with an instance count of seven. The uv grid on each surface is the third vertex attribute made visible.
svg.text: one vertex buffer, one index buffer, one draw call — seven tori
rendered offscreen at 512×288 and downloaded, then quantised to four shades of each tint
so that this figure is a few hundred rectangles rather than 147,456
2 — slot 0 per vertex, slot 1 per instance
